id.description: Id of the listing: one apartment community's rental listing. It is unique in the file, and so is `propertyId`.

propertyId.description: Id of the community, the `id` of its commercial-property record.

buildingName.description: Marketing name of the community, such as `City Lights on Fig`. Empty on 59 records.

address.description: Street address of the community: the property's primary address, with latitude and longitude.

totalNumUnits.description: Number of units in the community.

totalActiveUnits.description: Number of units across the floor plans in `apartmentModels`; the sum of their `numUnits`. It equals `totalNumUnits` on 1,597 records.

numUnitsAvailable.description: Number of units that can be rented now, the sum of the floor plans' `numUnitsAvailable`. Null on 11 records and 0 on 70.

minRent.description: Lowest asking rent across the community's floor plans, in dollars per month. 0 means no rent was given (571 records).

maxRent.description: Highest asking rent across the community's floor plans, in dollars per month.

monetaryUnit.description: Currency of the rents: 1 (US dollars) on 1,665 records and 0 (Unknown) on 82. Every community is in Texas or California.

minSquareFeet.description: Size of the smallest unit across the floor plans, in square feet.

maxSquareFeet.description: Size of the largest unit across the floor plans, in square feet.

lifestyleType.description: Who the community is for: 1 (All) the general market, 2 Senior, 3 Student, 5 Corporate. 0 on 4 records.

primarySubmarketId.description: Id of the community's CoStar submarket, as `primarySubmarketId` on the property record. The kit has ids only.

propertyManagementCompanyId.description: Id of the company location that manages the community. It joins to company-detail `id` on 1,072 records.

propertyManagementCompanyName.description: Name of the management company, such as `Greystar Real Estate Partners`.

propertyManagementCompanyHqLocationId.description: Id of the management company's headquarters location. It joins to company-detail `id` on 116 records.

apartmentModels.description: The community's floor plans, one entry each, with units, availability, size and asking rent.

id.description: Id of the address; equals `primaryAddress.id` on the property record.

streetNumberEndRange.description: Last street number when the address covers a range.

streetDirection.description: Direction before the street name, such as `S` or `NW`.

streetSuffix.description: Direction after the street name, such as `SW`.

buildingNumber.description: Building number or name within a complex.

postCode.description: ZIP code, five or nine digits without a hyphen.

countryCode.description: Three-letter country code, `USA` on every record.

latitude.description: Latitude of the address, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the address, in decimal degrees.

attachmentMasterId.description: Id of the photo. The same id is in the property record's `attachments` on 1,061 records.

attachmentType.description: Kind of photo: 4 (BuildingPhoto) on 1,432 records, 33 (InteriorPhoto) on 304 and 6 (Lobby) on 11.

caption.description: Caption of the photo, on 1,277 records.

attachmentUri.description: Link to the photo on CoStar's CDN at image size 112 (up to 1,880 by 900 pixels). Replace the `/112/` segment with 113 (1,400×720) or 116 (2,048×2,048) for another size.

id.description: Id of the floor plan; equals `propertyApartment.models[].id` on the property record, which carries the plan's amenities, attachments and units.

name.description: Name of the floor plan, such as `1x1` or `The Madison`. Empty on 277 plans.

numUnits.description: Number of units with this floor plan.

numUnitsAvailable.description: Number of those units that can be rented now. Null on 679 plans.

numBaths.description: Bathrooms, with half and quarter baths as decimals, such as 1.5 or 2.25.

maxOccupants.description: Most occupants allowed in a unit, where given (1,520 plans).

minSquareFeet.description: Size of the smallest unit with this floor plan, in square feet.

maxSquareFeet.description: Size of the largest unit with this floor plan, in square feet.

minRent.description: Lowest asking rent for this floor plan, in dollars per month on the basis `rentPricingType` gives. 0 means no rent was given (4,364 plans); null on 506.

maxRent.description: Highest asking rent for this floor plan, in dollars per month.

monetaryUnit.description: Currency of the plan's rents: 1 (US dollars) or 0 (Unknown, 532 plans).

rentPricingType.description: Basis of the rent: 1 (PerUnit) on 23,467 plans, 2 (PerBed, student housing rented by the bed) on 319, 3 (PerBedroom) on 20.
